newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products end mixed, gasoline rebounds.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products end mixed, gasoline rebounds.

text.p: NWE oil products ended steady to lower, with gasoline bouncing back late.
Diesel premiums came under further pressure from continuing supply from the U.S. market, but heating oil was steady at its already low level.
Fuel oil was a touch softer with very quiet barge activity knocking up to $2 a tonne. Cargoes were also easier on slow end-user interest.
Naphtha ended lower, watching crude volatility.
Gasoline ended down $1, helped by tight supplies and buying before the U.K. government's November 26 budget.
